about.title: A neighbourhood workshop where timber is still picked by hand
about.lead: Vilanova Carpentry SL is a joinery workshop and timber merchant on Carrer d'Eusebi Millan. People come for a single piece of wood, or for someone to take on the whole job.
about.body1: The work comes out of the workshop itself: measurements are taken at home or on site, the piece is prepared, then fitted. Between the timber rack and the bench is what makes a clean finish possible.
about.body2: Clients single out the way they are treated and the knack for solving things that are not in a catalogue. If a piece is not there, we work out how to make it.
about.fact4Label: boards and lengths to take away

features.title: From a full run of furniture to a site detail
features.lead: The workshop handles timber in large pieces and small joints alike. These are the jobs that come through most often.

furniture.title: Made-to-measure furniture
furniture.text: Shelving, tables, beds and pieces built for one particular corner of a home, at whatever size it takes.

wardrobes.title: Fitted wardrobes
wardrobes.text: Wardrobes and walk-ins that use the space from ceiling to floor, with sliding or hinged doors.

doors.title: Doors and windows
doors.text: Internal doors, frames and timber joinery for renovations and changes of look.

kitchens.title: Kitchens
kitchens.text: Cabinet fronts, base and wall units, and solid timber pieces to complete or redo a kitchen.

builders.title: Carpentry for builders
builders.text: Cuts, joints and pieces to measure for builders, plasterers and installers around the area.

repairs.title: Repairs and adjustments
repairs.text: Wobbly pieces, doors that catch, legs that need shortening: repaired, or made again.

menu.title: One job, four steps
menu.lead: Every job starts with a conversation and ends with the piece fitted. This is the usual route.
menu.note: The quote comes first and commits you to nothing: if the number does not suit you, nothing gets cut.

measure.title: Measuring up
measure.text: We come and look at the space, or you bring us the measurements. We agree the material and how the piece should sit.

quote.title: A clear quote
quote.text: You get the price before anything is cut, covering the material, the finish and the fitting.

make.title: Made in the workshop
make.text: The piece is built in the workshop. On a large job we tell you the realistic lead time from day one.

fit.title: Fitting and finishing
fit.text: We bring the finished work, install it, and go over the details with you before calling it done.

materials.title: Timber chosen, finish worked through
materials.text: We work solid timber and boards for interior use, finished with oil or varnish depending on where the piece is going. The yard keeps timber to take away and offcuts for trials.
materials.note: If you are unsure which material will hold up best in your home, ask at the workshop before buying.

reviews.title: What customers say
reviews.lead: Reviews posted on the workshop's Google listing, reproduced as they reached us.

advice.text: Incredible service and I am very happy with the result. There are few companies as serious and professional as this one. Angel has a solution for everything and gives excellent advice. I recommend him 100%.
advice.author: Begoña Capilla

chair.text: Very happy with the work done. They were kind enough to cut the legs off a chair for me, and it turned out exactly as I needed. They were very kind, quick and professional. Thank you for the attention and the good work.
chair.author: Veronica Sáez

contact.title: Talk to the workshop
contact.lead: The phone is the quickest route: tell us what you need and we will say whether a visit to measure up is required.
